reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE pp.product_id IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM promotion_products pp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE pp.promo_id IS NULL
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(pp.promo_id) = 0

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(pp.promo_id) = 0
other_way.tradeoff: Counting the matches per product and keeping 0 also works, but the IS NULL test is the shorter, usual anti-join.
